items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: Yeah, I played it for, uh, Paul Barber one time.

ctx.x: I think you can hear Dave Nelson on it pretty good, I believe that's him. I'm not sure. Could be.

Yeah, I played it for, uh, Paul Barber one time. But during that time, when he recorded, you kept your bass drum padded. Mm-hmm. You put quilts and all, everything in front of the bass. You didn't want to hear no bass drum. All you want to hear that snare drum, snare so down low, like a tom-tom effect, not quite a tom-tom effect. Mm-hmm. And when you hit the cymbal, you don't hit it with the sticks. You use a soft mallet. Mm-hmm. You hit the cymbal and choke it. Cut it off.
You make the needle jump on the record some days.
